clues.text: At Capernaum, Jesus told Peter to cast a hook and look in the first fish's mouth for it.
Jesus said this one, worth four drachmas, would pay the two-drachma tax for both Him and Peter.
When the Herodians asked about paying taxes to Caesar, Jesus said to show Him this, and they brought a denarius.
Questioned with the Herodians present, Jesus asked whose image and inscription were on it, and they answered, "Caesar's."
In Jesus' story, a woman who had ten of these lost one, lit a lamp, and swept her house.
Jesus told of a woman who found her lost one and called her friends and neighbors to rejoice with her.
Jesus compared finding a lost one to the joy before God's angels over one sinner who repents.
